name: durable-backend-variable-gap
title: Provision the durable backend variables no install creates
description: The installed durable lane reads SD_REVIEW_CHEAP_BACKEND_V1 and SD_REVIEW_DEEP_BACKEND_V1, which no install ever creates
creator: sdelmas
notes: Severity corrected during planning review: not a rollout blocker. The installed template's copilot review floor keeps --remote auto on the copilot route, so canary 1 passes. The gap is reached by an explicit --remote cheap|deep, which the floor does not override.
